title: Start today
header_line: My analysis of one book on an entrepreneur's life. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What problem do you wish someone would just start fixing today?
I asked: does anybody know why he calls it the boring company? A student said it could be the boring of boring a hole. I said: I can't believe I missed that.

How does he decide to start a brand-new company? I said: traffic is driving me nuts. It's a problem, and I'm not the only one who has it. So he asks: does everybody else have this problem? And then he says: let's get it going.

Very action-oriented, I said. We have talked a lot about people who say: I don't have the time. Imagine this man's time, with several companies already. And all of a sudden he says: let's start another business. Buy two machines. How does he do that?
A student said: he is able to jump on these things right away and find the right people. Now that he has built up a network of people interested in it, he can leverage it and get to work.
I said: that was a key thing you just said. One of the challenges we know is how to build the team. I don't know where to get these people, and not everybody is built to be an entrepreneur.
How is he finding people? A student said: through his network and referrals, and he has created messaging that filters the people who come to him.
Who is in your network that you could call today?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write a problem you have, and who else has it.
Write what you could do today, not next month.
Write who is in your network that could help.
Write the message that would filter the right people to you.
Write what you will do before the day is out.

check.q: How did I say the person decides to start a new company?
choices: He sees a problem and asks whether everybody else has it

check.q: What did a student say lets him start at once?
choices: His network of people interested in it

check.q: What did a student say filters the people who come to him?

recap: See the problem. Check whether others have it. Start today with your network.
